name: spectrum
description: Connects Claude Code, Codex and Copilot to a Spectrum knowledge graph of your project and reminds the agent to consult it about intent, impact, feature-to-code mapping and business rules before reading code.

consult_gate.title: Consult gate
consult_gate.description: Once the agent has made several code searches or reads with no Spectrum call in between, refuse the next one, at most once per time window, with a reason that tells it to ask Spectrum first. Off by default.

consult_gate_after.title: Consult gate: searches before a refusal
consult_gate_after.description: How many code searches or reads with no Spectrum call in between the consult gate lets through before it refuses one.

consult_gate_window_seconds.title: Consult gate: seconds between refusals
consult_gate_window_seconds.description: The consult gate refuses at most one call in this many seconds; every other call goes through.
